entries.title: Proverbs 29:1
segments: ¶He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and without remedy.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:2
segments: ¶When the righteous increase, the people rejoice; but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:3
segments: ¶Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; but he that is a companion of harlots destroyeth [his] substance.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:4
segments: ¶A king by just judgment establisheth the land; but he that taketh gifts overthroweth it.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:5
segments: ¶A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:6
segments: ¶In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; but the righteous shall sing and rejoice.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:7
segments: ¶The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; the wicked understandeth not knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:8
segments: ¶Scornful men set the city in a flame; but the wise turn away anger.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:9
segments: ¶If a wise man contendeth with a fool, whether he rage or laugh, [he] hath no rest.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:10
segments: ¶The bloodthirsty hate the perfect, but the upright care for his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:11
segments: ¶A fool uttereth all his mind; but a wise [man] keepeth it back.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:12
segments: ¶If a ruler hearken to lying words, all his servants are wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:13
segments: ¶The indigent and the oppressor meet together; Jehovah lighteneth the eyes of them both.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:14
segments: ¶A king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:15
segments: ¶The rod and reproof give wisdom; but a child left [to himself] bringeth his mother to shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:16
segments: ¶When the wicked increase, transgression increaseth; but the righteous shall see their fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:17
segments: ¶Chasten thy son, and he shall give thee rest, and shall give delight unto thy soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:18
segments: ¶Where there is no vision the people cast off restraint; but happy is he that keepeth the law.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:19
segments: ¶A servant is not corrected by words: he understandeth indeed, but he will not answer.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:20
segments: ¶Hast thou seen a man hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:21
segments: ¶He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child, shall in the end have him as a son.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:22
segments: ¶An angry man exciteth contention; and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:23
segments: ¶A man's pride bringeth him low; but the humble in spirit shall obtain honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:24
segments: ¶Whoso shareth with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth the adjuration, and declareth not.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:25
segments: ¶The fear of man bringeth a snare; but whoso putteth his confidence in Jehovah is protected.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:26
segments: ¶Many seek the ruler's face; but a man's right judgment is from Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:27
segments: ¶An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; and he that is of upright way is an abomination to the wicked [man].
